name: PD 125 was established by Ordinance No. 16841, passed by the Dallas City Council on January 28, 1981. Ordinance No. 16841 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 16841; 25508)
source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 125 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text: SEC. 51P-125.101.LEGISLATIVE HISTORY. PD 125 was established by Ordinance No. 16841, passed by the Dallas City Council on January 28, 1981. Ordinance No. 16841 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 16841; 25508)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text: SEC. 51P-125.102.PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE. PD 125 is established on property generally located along the southwest line of Park Lane and the east line of Stoneshire Lane, west of Boedeker Street. The size of PD 125 is approximately 30.008 acres. (Ord. Nos. 16841; 25508)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-125.103.DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.
(a)Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51 apply to this article.
(b)Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51. (Ord. 25508)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text: SEC. 51P-125.104.DEVELOPMENT PLAN. A development plan, as approved by the city plan commission, is labelled Exhibit 125A. Development must be in accordance with the setbacks, lot arrangement, and street location shown on the plan. (Ord. Nos. 16841; 25508)

sections.title: Subdivision Plat
sections.text: SEC. 51P-125.105.SUBDIVISION PLAT. Prior to the issuance of any building permit, a subdivision plat approved by the city plan commission must be filed for record with the county clerk. In conjunction with the submission of the subdivision plat, a legal instrument establishing a plan for permanent care and maintenance of any common area or communally-owned facility must be submitted to and approved by the city attorney as to legal form and by the city plan commission as to suitability for the proposed use of the common area. (Ord. Nos. 16841; 25508)

sections.title: Uses
sections.text: SEC. 51P-125.106.USES. Development within this PD is limited to single-family detached uses to be developed to Townhouse-4 District standards, except as otherwise noted. (Ord. Nos. 16841; 25508)

sections.title: Density
sections.text: SEC. 51P-125.107.DENSITY. The development is limited to 134 dwelling units. (Ord. Nos. 16841; 25508)

sections.title: Height
sections.text: SEC. 51P-125.108.HEIGHT. Maximum height for all development may not exceed 28 feet in height. (Ord. Nos. 16841; 25508)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text: SEC. 51P-125.109.SIGNS. All signs must comply with the non-business category of Chapter 41 of the 1960 Revised Code of Civil and Criminal Ordinances of the city. (Ord. Nos. 16841; 25508; 26102)

sections.title: Landscape Plan
sections.text: SEC. 51P-125.110.LANDSCAPE PLAN. A detailed landscape plan must be submitted for city plan commission approval showing all proposed water areas, berms, plantings common areas, and other relevant landscaped areas, prior to the issuance of a building permit. (Ord. Nos. 16841; 25508)

sections.title: Walls
sections.text: SEC. 51P-125.111.WALLS. All perimeter walls must be solid, continuous masonry built to a height indicated on the development and landscape plans. (Ord. Nos. 16841; 25508)

sections.title: Paving
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-125.112.PAVING.
(a)All streets, driveways, parking spaces, and maneuvering areas for parking must be constructed to the requirements of Section 20-812 of Chapter 51.
(b)All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 16841; 25508; 26102)

sections.title: Maintenance
sections.text: SEC. 51P-125.113.MAINTENANCE. All common areas and walls must be maintained in a state of good repair and all common area and relevant landscaped areas must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition at all times. (Ord. Nos. 16841; 25508)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text: SEC. 51P-125.114.GENERAL REQUIREMENTS. Development of this property must comply with the requirements of all departments of the city. (Ord. Nos. 16841; 25508; 26102)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text: SEC. 51P-125.115.COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS. The building official shall not issue a certificate of occupancy until there is full compliance with this article and with all applicable provisions of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 16841; 25508)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text: SEC. 51P-125.116.ZONING MAP. PD 125 is located on Zoning Map No. F-8. (Ord. Nos. 16841; 25508)
